english.title: Assault a person thereby occasioning them actual bodily harm
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), assaulted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), thereby occasioning

(A)_[him,]_
(B)_[her,]_

actual bodily harm
english.legislation: Contrary to section 47 of the Offences Against the Person Act 1861.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and location
assaulted a person
thereby occasioning him / her
actual bodily harm

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Officers should ensure that they know the C.P.S. guidelines for this offence before preparing any charges. When investigating this offence consideration must be given to the advice offered in the assault charging standards.
(ii) Where this offence is committed against an emergency worker this must be treated as an aggravating factor in sentencing, see section 67 of the Sentencing Act 2020.
(iii) See section 72 of the Domestic Abuse Act 2021 regarding the committing of this offence outside the UK by a UK national or a person habitually resident in England and Wales.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Five years imprisonment.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
